newsitem.title: FRANCE: BNP sees H1 profit growth above target.
newsitem.headline: BNP sees H1 profit growth above target.

text.p: French bank BNP said in a statement on Thursday that first-half profit should exceed the bank's original growth target.
"The net result in the first half should, barring exceptional circumstances, exceed growth targets that the company set itself," it said.
The second-half result would depend on "the evolution of the (banking) environment" it said.
BNP said bank chairman Michel Pebereau had told shareholders at the annual general meeting that the first months of 1997 showed a continuation of trends seen during the second half of 1996.
The banking and international finance division benefited from favourable environments in North America and in Asia as well as from stronger financial markets, notably in France.
Banking activity in France was also stronger, helped by greater loan demand from individuals but corporate loan demand remained weak. There was also still tough competition on margins, it said.
